name: hayalet-ev
description: Hayalet Ev - İnsan ve AI arasında kolektif zihin platformu

scripts.electron:build: esbuild electron/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --packages=external --outfile=dist-electron/main.js --format=esm && cp electron/preload.cjs electron/webview-preload.cjs dist-electron/
scripts.electron:dev: npm run electron:build && concurrently -k -s first "vite" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 && CDP_PORT=9223 LIBVA_DRIVER_NAME=i965 electron ./dist-electron/main.js --no-sandbox 2>&1 | grep -v -E 'xapp-gtk3-module|bind\(\) failed|Cannot start http server for devtools'"
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run check-types
scripts.check:all: npm run check && npm run build
scripts.docs:generate: cd mcp-server && npm run build && cd .. && node scripts/generate-tool-docs.js
scripts.git-sync: git add . && git commit -m "Sync" && git push
scripts.update:check:
npx npm-check-updates && echo '
--- MCP Server ---' && cd mcp-server && npx npm-check-updates
scripts.update:safe: npx npm-check-updates -u --target minor && npm install && cd mcp-server && npx npm-check-updates -u --target minor && npm install
scripts.update:deps: npx npm-check-updates -u --reject electron,electron-builder && npm install && cd mcp-server && npx npm-check-updates -u && npm install
scripts.update:full: npx npm-check-updates -u && npm install && cd mcp-server && npx npm-check-updates -u && npm install
scripts.update:interactive: npx npm-check-updates -i --format group && cd mcp-server && npx npm-check-updates -i --format group

author: Raistlin, Nexa, Gök
